<!--
  Thanks for contributing! Please read CONTRIBUTING.md before opening a PR.

  Pull requests must be linked to an accepted issue. The templates are deliberately
  small and opinionated, so we agree on the change in an issue before any code is
  written. PRs that don't reference an accepted issue may be closed without review.

  Exception: trivial fixes (typos, broken links, comment-only changes) don't need an
  issue. Replace the whole "Fixes #<issue-number>" line below with the single word
  "trivial".
-->

## Linked issue

<!-- Required. Use a closing keyword so GitHub links them, e.g. "Fixes #123". For an exempt change, replace the whole line with "trivial". -->

Fixes #<issue-number>

## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change, and why? Keep it to a few sentences; the detail belongs in the issue. -->

## How was this tested?

<!-- Which template(s) did you generate and run, and what did you check? -->

## Checklist

- [ ] The linked issue has been accepted by a maintainer (or this change is trivial)
- [ ] The change is scoped to what the issue describes; unrelated changes are in separate PRs
- [ ] `pnpm generate` was run and the regenerated metadata is committed
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
